sources.snippet: The fsmn-vad system is a production-ready Voice Activity Detection solution that identifies speech segments in audio streams using FSMN neural networks. Originally developed by Alibaba's Speech Lab and available through ModelScope and FunASR, this implementation provides a lightweight, portable VAD system with ONNX Runtime integration.
